ops-bot: Canary scheduled in prod: Fri 09:00 UTC. Monitoring: p50/p95/errors/qa-probes.
frank.ops: Will capture in-app quick feedback for canary traffic.
nina.cs: Renewal touchpoint in 2 weeks; good results will be included in renewal brief.
sam.se: Canary live. Watching metrics.
